claim: Every paid plan starts with a 7-day free trial
quote: Every paid plan starts with a 7-day free trial.

claim: Yearly billing saves about one month
quote: Toggle to yearly billing on the pricing page or during signup to save the equivalent of one month per year.

claim: Video minutes counted when a response includes video URLs
quote: A video minute is counted when your API request returns exercise data that includes video URLs.

claim: Requests are not blocked past the minute limit
quote: We never block requests. If you run past your monthly minutes your API keeps responding, and we get in touch to help you move to a plan that fits your traffic, no surprise charges.

claim: Exercise video limit: 250 on Starter, 350 on Pro, rolling 30 days, monthly billing
quote: The exercise video limit is about variety: it counts how many different exercises you have pulled with video in a rolling 30-day window, 250 on Starter and 350 on Pro with monthly billing.

claim: Scale, Enterprise and yearly plans have no exercise video limit; includeVideos=false counts toward neither
quote: Scale, Enterprise and every yearly plan have no exercise video limit.

claim: Form analyses past the allowance cost $0.25 each
quote: After your included analyses are used, additional analyses are billed at $0.25 each.

claim: Food, barcode and recipe searches unlimited on every plan
quote: Food searches, barcode scans and recipe searches are unlimited on every plan.

claim: Starter watermarked, Pro and above clean
quote: Starter plan videos include a small Your Move watermark. Pro and above get clean, unwatermarked videos ready for white-label use in your app.

claim: No resale or redistribution of the videos
quote: You cannot redistribute, sub-license, or resell the video content to other developers.

claim: Training or bulk downloading needs a separate data license
quote: The only exception is the video files: training, fine-tuning or motion-tracking models on the videos, or bulk downloading them, needs a separate data license.

claim: Self-hosting is a separate license; Scale and Enterprise may cache for offline use
quote: On Scale and Enterprise your app can also cache videos on the user's device for offline workouts.

claim: Self-hosting license
quote: And if you'd rather run the files on your own infrastructure, we offer that as a separate self-hosting license - happy to talk it through.

claim: Signup: no charge until the trial ends
quote: Start with a 7-day free trial. No charge until your trial ends.

claim: Docs: Starter (basic) plan allowances: 10,000 minutes, 10 form analyses, 1 brand
quote: { "plan": "basic", "minutesLimit": 10000, "postureLimit": 10, "brandLimit": 1 },

claim: Over the cap, video URLs are removed from exercises not previously accessed
quote: When the cap is exceeded, the API still returns exercise data but removes the video URLs ( videoUrl , videoHlsUrl , videoDurationSecs ) from exercises you have not previously accessed. Thumbnails are kept.

claim: Docs: Trial and Starter watermarked, Pro and Enterprise clean
quote: Watermarking: Trial and Starter plans receive watermarked videos. Pro and Enterprise plans receive clean, unwatermarked videos.

claim: Video URLs expire after 48 hours
quote: Video URLs returned by the API are pre-signed and temporary. They will stop working after 48 hours.

claim: POST /upgrade subscriptions have no trial
quote: Subscriptions start immediately (no trial period).

claim: Brand license per website and mobile app
quote: Every API subscription includes a Brand License that limits API content use to the Brands you register with us. Each Brand covers one website and one mobile application under the same brand name.

claim: Yearly plans have no monthly exercise cap; access over limits may be throttled
quote: We may throttle, degrade, or suspend access that exceeds these limits.

claim: Videos licensed only while subscribed; delete cached files
quote: Videos are licensed to you only while your subscription is active.

claim: Trial converts to paid unless cancelled
quote: If you do not cancel before the trial ends, your subscription converts to the paid plan you selected and your payment method is charged automatically.

claim: General terms: personal, non-commercial or internal business use; last updated August 07, 2025
quote: The Content and Marks are provided in or through the Services "AS IS" for your personal, non-commercial use or internal business purpose only.

claim: 25 free clips, free for commercial use, do not resell
quote: You may not sell or redistribute the videos as a standalone product or library.
